correctness.rationale: Summing the exact logit updates forces the arithmetic mean m; the instantaneous q-update forces the belief coordinates. The one-variable divided logit difference H_m(d) has a strictly positive derivative, exact endpoint limits 2/[m(1-m)] and infinity, and therefore produces precisely one positive d if and only if a(1-r)>2/[m(1-m)]. The L''' coefficient proves the square-root law; the two-step Jacobian trace/determinant and convex trapezoidal inequality establish the transverse Schur assertions. The exact rational/logarithmic witness, an exact-rational interval proof of its Schur inequalities, and symbolic identities were replayed using the standalone checker.

value.rationale: This is a complete, exact, and naturally motivated periodic-orbit census for a permitted maximal belief response in the newly studied risk-sensitive dynamical model. The absolute no-two-cycle regime cp1>=1 is a structural obstruction at all learning rates; below it, a sharp analytic threshold and square-root branch emerge, with a separate stability transition at cp1=1/3. These dynamics are not read off from prior sampled bifurcation pictures and are useful for interpreting how delayed endogenous belief stabilizes or suppresses alternating behavior.
